reason: Checked against the source. update_mover's only caller is update_movers_loop (LDY movers_to_update,X : STY mover_to_update : JSR update_mover), so Y = mover_to_update on entry and the new prologue never changes Y. The arithmetic is right: LDA #&F5 : CMP viewport_right_low leaves C = NOT(carry of right_low + &0A). SBC then gives x_high - (right_high + c), with no wrap because right_high <= &1D. A borrow means on screen, nonzero means leave, and zero means C = 1, so ADC #&09 = right_low + &0A for the low-byte CMP. That is the old test exactly, including x_high = &FF for removed movers. The skipped get_mover_Y_x_and_y writes mover_x_low (&F8), &C5 and mover_y (&F9, which is also column_length_in_bytes, pixel and scenery_pixel_value). Every reader sets these first: the collision check's JSR get_mover_Y_x_and_y on the update path; plot_mover, which writes &F8 and &C5 itself (walk_column and check_if_mover_is_on_screen read only those) on the animate path; and animate_mover and search_for_target_with_offset, which set mover_y. update_enemy_helicopter runs after the loop every pass and unconditionally does check_if_mover_can_be_updated -> check_for_player_collision_with_mover_Y -> get_mover_Y_x_and_y, then overwrites all three. So the zero page render_pass and restore_game_zp save is unchanged. Nothing else reads these bytes between update_mover calls, and the IRQ only flips. Paging: the tables are in main RAM at &1300-&1366, below &3000, so ROMSEL and ACCCON's X bit do not matter. The stub after the always-taken BNE replot_mover is reached only by BCS, and nothing falls through into it or refers to update_mover by offset. Built in a scratch copy: the plain build assembles with every symbol at the same address except update_mover, um0db5_is_on_screen (&2CCD->&2CD6) and the new stub (&2CB6). um0db5_update (&2CDF), leave_3160, animate_explosion_or_skeleton and the tables are unmoved, all new branches stay inside page &2C, and the movers_x ASSERTs hold. The gameplay build (padding dropped, 3 bytes saved) also assembles. Generated sources, data, tables, raster-timed code and PROTECTED lines are not touched. Cycles on the common path (on screen, no carry, type < &0D), old: JSR get_mover_Y_x_and_y 33 + CLC/LDX/LDA/ADC/BCC/CPX/BCC/BNE/LDY/LDA,Y/AND/CMP/BCC 35 = 68. New: 2+3+4+3+3+4+2+2+2 = 25, saving 43. The off-screen leave paths save more, so the claimed weighted average of 34.4 is plausible. Bytes: 0 on the plain disc (3 bytes of padding); 3 saved in GAMEPLAY_ANY builds.
